title: Massachusetts homeowners say state is ignoring cost in push toward all electric heat
summary: A Boston TV consumer report on Massachusetts homeowners whose electric bills soared after switching from gas or oil to heat pumps, and new heat pump winter rates.

assertions.quote: THEY SAY IT'S CERTAINLY EFFICIENT AT BURNING THROUGH THEIR MONEY.
THE STATE NEEDS TO BRING DOWN ELECTRICITY COSTS TO DRIVE WIDER ADOPTION OF ELECTRIC HEAT.
DPU IS ORDERING UTILITIES TO PROVIDE REDUCED ELECTRIC RATES IN WINTER FOR CUSTOMERS WITH HEAT PUMPS.
THEY HARDLY USED TO PAY AN ELECTRIC BILL, OWING NATIONAL GRID LESS THAN $800 TOTAL FOR ALL OF LAST WINTER.
HEATS HIS HOUSE MORE EVENLY THAN HIS OLD OIL SYSTEM, BUT SAYS THE COST OF THAT HEAT DOUBLED THIS WINTER.
